crossRefs.note: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
(for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

translations.web: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
translations.bsb: The eye that saw him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.
translations.kjv: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold
translations.asv: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.
